description: The pelvis forms a sturdy bowl that transfers weight from spine to legs while opening dramatic planes for figure drawing.

landmarks.name: Iliac crest
landmarks.desc: Broad ridge sweeping from ASIS to PSIS, a key landmark for hip rhythms.

landmarks.name: Anterior superior iliac spine
landmarks.desc: Forward point that sets the waist triangle and anchors sartorius origins.

landmarks.name: Posterior superior iliac spine
landmarks.desc: Dimpled rear marker where the sacrum meets the ilium in gentle pits.

landmarks.name: Pubic symphysis
landmarks.desc: Midline joint tying left and right pubic bodies, guiding the groin wedge.

landmarks.name: Ischial tuberosity
landmarks.desc: Sitting bone that bears weight when seated and anchors hamstring tendons.

landmarks.name: Acetabulum
landmarks.desc: Socket that receives the femoral head and defines the hip's spherical pivot.

landmarks.name: Anterior inferior iliac spine
landmarks.desc: Forward projection just below the ASIS where the rectus femoris takes a direct origin.

landmarks.name: Supraacetabular groove
landmarks.desc: Smooth notch on the superior rim of the acetabulum that receives the reflected head of the rectus femoris.

landmarks.name: Iliac fossa
landmarks.desc: Broad concave inner surface of the ilium that cradles iliacus fibers.

landmarks.name: Body of pubis
landmarks.desc: Anterior surface of the pubic body that offers a flat plane for the medial thigh tendons to grip.

landmarks.name: Inferior pubic ramus
landmarks.desc: Slender arch descending toward the ischium, giving origin to the short adductors.

landmarks.name: Ischial ramus
landmarks.desc: Medial bridge between pubis and ischium where deep adductor fibers span the obturator foramen.

landmarks.name: Posterior iliac crest
landmarks.desc: Thick crest along the rear ilium where gluteus maximus fibers fan outward.

landmarks.name: Gluteal surface of ilium
landmarks.desc: Broad lateral plate between the gluteal lines that feeds the gluteus medius fan.

landmarks.name: Anterior gluteal surface
landmarks.desc: Lower lateral ilium tucked beneath medius where gluteus minimus originates.
